[0] Less is more when it comes to how I use the Apple Watch. The best experience, for me, requires few notifications and intentional focus on what I want out of the device. This approach applies to Apple Watch faces too. While there are no new watch faces in watchOS 27 yet, I’ve been loving a scaled-back version of a very information-dense option.

[1] A more modular, less ultra version of Modular Ultra face

[2] Modular Ultra, exclusive to Apple Watch Ultra, is one of those faces that can look super different based on how you configure it.

[3] My approach prioritizes the time in large size with seconds visible. This is especially nice on Apple Watch Ultra 3, which always displays the seconds, including in always-on mode.

[4] The bottom left complication is current temperature with low and high. The top right complication currently displays my activity rings, though I change this slot sometimes based on interest. I swap it out for UV index sometimes.

[5] The other four small complication slots are blank. I like the opposite corner balance and what the negative space offers.

[6] You can configure Modular Ultra with way more data

[7] As an example of what Modular Ultra is capable of display, I’ve also configured a version that shows its full capacity.

[8] It can show six compact complications, a medium complication under the smaller clock, and bezel data that can include seconds, depth, elevation, or training load.

[9] I think it’s great that the Modular Ultra face can display so much information. For my day-to-day needs, I just get more out of the toned-down version.

[10] The one weird quirk that this face has in the restrained mode is the red notification dot placement. Because it’s positioned to accommodate a top-middle complication slot, the dot isn’t centered in how I use the watch face. That’s actually just one more thing I like about the layout: it’s a little weird and different.

[11] Which watch faces are you loving these days? Share your thoughts in the comments.

[12] Apple Watch Ultra 3 is currently available from $699 (reg. $799) on Amazon. Apple’s refurbished store also carries Apple Watch Ultra 2 for $589.
